correctness.rationale: The unitary Zak normalization is explicit; finite support yields exactly two three-term polynomials. The middle coefficient dominates the other two for all parameters, making z=-1 a COMMON global minimizer of both moduli and z=1 a common maximizer. Exact convex piecewise quadratic optimization in the physical coordinate produces the complete A,B formulas. The feasibility conditions 4/11<=a<=3/7 and the two equality quadratics yield precisely the asserted thresholds. Continuity at both switches and b=3/2, strict A>0, and direct independent lattice sums in the standalone checker were verified. Finite tests do not establish the continuous minimax proof.

value.rationale: This is a natural complete sharp-optimal-frame-bound classification on the lower half of the critical hat-spline half-density family, not an arbitrary finite parameter slice. It reveals two genuine first-order geometric transitions between centered and separated Zak minimizers, yields the exact reconstruction condition number for every real parameter in the interval, and joins the previously published complementary sharp-bound interval at b=3/2. Exact optimizer phase/geometric transitions are not implied by qualitative frame membership.
